text.title: Pr Pattern Mining For Feedback Decision Tree
text.summary: Routing tree mapping observable corpus signals (PR count, recurrence, formatter coverage, prior report) to a rule from `content/01-core-rules.xml`. Every leaf names a concrete rule id, `run-the-checklist`, or `skip-this-methodology` when the sample cannot support a report.

decision-tree.root-question: Does the mined window contain at least 20 merged PRs and 100 review comments, fetched by a stated query?

conclusion.verdict: skip-this-methodology: label the corpus insufficient-sample, record observations only, and widen the window or wait a cycle before suggesting rules

branch.question: Does any candidate finding recur in at least 3 distinct PRs from at least 2 distinct reviewers?

conclusion.verdict: report 'no recurring pattern' with the single-occurrence list and comment URLs; do not suggest rules

branch.question: Are the most frequent recurring comments enforceable by a formatter or linter already available for the language?

conclusion.verdict: collapse them into one automation-gap item naming the tool config change; re-rank the remainder by frequency times round-trips

branch.question: Does a prior report exist for the same scope and query?

conclusion.verdict: compute the delta per pattern against the prior baseline; mark rules with no drop after two cycles ineffective before adding new ones
run the full report: corpus statement, patterns as code behaviour with examples, top-5 ranked by frequency times cost, enforcement channel per rule, scope declared, baseline and re-measure date set

text.example: Observable: 64 merged PRs, 412 review comments, 2026-04-01..2026-06-30, query `gh api graphql` saved in the report → 3 recurring patterns (missing `timeout=` on `requests` calls, 11 PRs, 4 reviewers; tests asserting status code only, 7 PRs, 3 reviewers; N+1 query in list endpoints, 5 PRs, 2 reviewers); import-order comments (38) collapsed into one `ruff` I001 automation-gap; no prior report → conclusion: run-the-checklist.
